sourceReceipts.title: The Most Useful New AI Features and Tools to Try
sourceReceipts.notes: The complete edition Markdown and complete available transcript were read. AIDB argues that a cluster of browser, context, plugin, transcription and video-interface changes has thinned the line between assistant and operator. LAiDIES retains the harness-versus-model mechanism and the move from suggestion to action, but not the episode's implied equivalence between browser access and reliable completion. The edition dek says NVIDIA confirmed a $12.9B Hugging Face purchase; neither company had published an official announcement when checked, and current reporting conflicted on whether an agreement existed. That claim remains UNVERIFIED and must not be published as fact. Sponsor and product discovery claims were not admitted as recommendations.

sourceReceipts.title: Use the built-in browser in Claude Cowork
sourceReceipts.notes: Anthropic documents a gradual rollout to Cowork on desktop for Pro, Max and Team, with Enterprise owner control. The separate browser can import selected cookies, remembers sign-ins, asks for first-site permission and blocks some high-risk sites. Anthropic explicitly says safeguards cannot remove prompt-injection risk and advises against sensitive financial, medical or third-party personal-data actions. Availability and safety remain plan, platform, rollout and task specific.

sourceReceipts.title: Using cloud browser in ChatGPT
sourceReceipts.notes: OpenAI documents a separate cloud computer for ChatGPT Work on paid plans in supported regions, excluding Free and Go. It may combine connected apps with browser actions, pauses for sign-in or confirmation, and does not inherit the user's device browser sessions. OpenAI tells users to verify sensitive steps and results because safeguards do not eliminate prompt injection, phishing or unintended-action risk.

sourceReceipts.title: Temporary Chat FAQ
sourceReceipts.notes: OpenAI now distinguishes non-personalized and personalized Temporary Chats. Personalized temporary chats may use existing memories, custom instructions and plugins but do not create new memories unless saved; unsaved temporary chats stay out of history and may be retained for up to 30 days for safety. This is a current product rule, not a general privacy guarantee, and account or workspace restrictions still apply.

sourceReceipts.title: Salesforce and Anthropic Announce Claudeforce
sourceReceipts.notes: The companies announce a Salesforce-in-Claude pilot with 37 sales skills and say Salesforce routes actions through business rules and governance. Select pilots are current, with an open beta expected in September 2026. Product availability is verified as provider-primary; productivity, safety and governance effectiveness claims remain vendor claims without independent outcome evidence.

sourceReceipts.title: OpenAI model access after Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX
sourceReceipts.notes: Cursor says SpaceX completed its acquisition on August 14. OpenAI says it intends to wind down model service to Cursor, proposes a November 12 cutoff and will not provide future models. OpenAI's contract and terms allegations are its attributed rationale, not an adjudicated fact. Replacement models, customer migration terms and whether the proposed date executes remain unknown; any current Cursor guidance that assumes OpenAI-model access must be rechecked by November 12 or earlier on a company update.

sourceReceipts.title: AI agents can act. That's the security problem.
sourceReceipts.notes: The Neuron interview preserves Alice CEO Noam Schwartz's attributed view that agent security spans data, tools, memory, permissions and continuous tests. The phrase that risk is almost infinite is rhetoric, not incident evidence. The mechanism duplicates existing agent-permissions work and is retained as merge-only context.

sourceReceipts.title: Iterating Development Workflows with Codex
sourceReceipts.notes: Bounded archive review. The recipe says AGENTS.md is recognized but optional and the other files are conventions, not Codex requirements. Its durable value is to capture only context that changes decisions, verification and future work, then preserve repository-specific and reusable lessons separately. It is an internal-practice candidate, not reader guidance without a simpler non-developer translation and a bounded result.

sourceReceipts.title: Migrate from Whisper to GPT-Transcribe and GPT-Live-Transcribe
sourceReceipts.notes: Bounded archive review. The provider documents separate current migration paths for completed audio and low-latency live audio, with changed fields, hints and output handling. This is implementation-specific developer guidance; it does not establish transcription quality for LAiDIES audio without a current representative test. Retained archive-only.

sourceReceipts.title: AML Analysis with the Agents SDK on Amazon Bedrock
sourceReceipts.notes: Bounded archive review. The synthetic notebook separates deterministic evidence, model proposals, application controls and qualified-human authority. It recomputes claim support instead of checking citation syntax alone, prevents the model from authorizing drafting or filing through structured fields and includes negative tests. It does not implement production compliance policy or prove orchestration on its default offline path. The durable boundary pattern merges with existing permission and evidence work.

opportunities.title: Explain the changing system of skills for working with AI
opportunities.readerValue: Readers can recognize that effective AI work now spans context, memory, projects, reusable skills, agents, tools, permissions, loops and verification rather than treating prompt length as the whole practice.
opportunities.facts: AIDB published skills-map, advanced-user and assistant-to-operator episodes. OpenAI and Anthropic now document separate browser environments, signed-in-session boundaries, plan-specific availability, confirmation and prompt-injection limitations. OpenAI documents personalized Temporary Chats that may use existing context without creating new memories. Salesforce and Anthropic document a pilot that combines model reasoning with a system of record and business rules. Cursor and OpenAI show that a product's model access can change after ownership and contract changes.
opportunities.attributedInterpretation: AIDB frames recent interface and harness changes as the practical move from assistant to operator. Salesforce and Anthropic argue that enterprise data, rules and workflows remain valuable around models. OpenAI frames its Cursor cutoff as contractual and safety accountability; Cursor frames its SpaceX acquisition as a path to stronger and cheaper models.
opportunities.laidiesInference: The useful unit is no longer a prompt in isolation. It is a task plus model, harness, context, memory, tools, external systems, permissions, stop conditions, verification and a human decision owner. Moving from suggestion to action makes access and accountability more important, while model access inside a product is contingent rather than permanent.

opportunities.title: Teach agentic delegation through permissions, boundaries and review
opportunities.readerValue: Readers can understand why giving AI tools changes the job from writing a better prompt to deciding what to delegate, defining access, checking the result and owning the consequences.
opportunities.facts: Mollick and AIDB establish a delegation frame. OpenAI, METR and Hugging Face supply a reconciled incident record. OpenAI and Anthropic now document browser agents with separate sessions, permissions, confirmations and explicit residual prompt-injection risk. The evidence-grounded AML example separates deterministic evidence, model proposals, application controls and qualified-human authority.
opportunities.attributedInterpretation: AIDB argues that browser and harness upgrades are moving assistants toward operators. OpenAI and Anthropic present product safeguards while warning that they cannot remove every risk. The Neuron interview argues that security must span data, tools, memory, permissions and continuous tests, but its extreme-risk language remains vendor interpretation.
opportunities.laidiesInference: Browser access turns a fluent answer into a consequential workflow. Good delegation requires least privilege, isolated or intentionally shared state, approved communications, safe stop conditions, evidence that validates claim support rather than citation syntax, active monitoring and a human who can halt and own the work.
